tasks.label: run
tasks.detail: Compila y ejecuta App.java (menu interactivo) con JDK 21.

tasks.label: reset
tasks.detail: Borra bin/, recompila todo y vuelve a correr los tests JUnit.
tasks.command: if (Test-Path bin) { Remove-Item bin -Recurse -Force }; & "$env:JDK\javac.exe" -d bin -cp "lib/*" -sourcepath src (Get-ChildItem -Recurse src -Filter *.java).FullName; if ($?) { & "$env:JDK\java.exe" -jar "lib/junit-platform-console-standalone-1.10.0.jar" -cp "bin;lib/gson-2.10.1.jar" --scan-classpath bin }
